scope: Owner report 2026-09-23 ("New game still does not work ... Still cannot start new game"). On dev, NEW GAME with an existing save opens a confirm sheet whose START NEW button is disabled for 1.5 s and then completes only after an unbroken 0.8 s press. Nothing on screen named the gesture: the ghost hand points at KEEP GAME, a tap produced no response, and the existing probe only grepped the constants, so a grown-up's taps silently did nothing. The hold stays (it keeps a child's quick taps from replacing the adventure); START NEW now carries a 22 px adult caption, PRESS AND HOLD, below the button and a gold bar that fills inside the button for the length of the hold. A press lifted early empties the bar and pulses the caption. The confirm shell grows 36 px to hold the caption. A new trusted probe drives the real menu with pointer presses on an isolated save, from a disarmed tap through an early lift to a full hold, then boots a fresh main on the installed save to prove it lands in a fresh Day One. No save keys, New Game archive/transaction logic, voice, arm delay, hold length or other menu behaviour change.
no_findings_reason: The undiscoverable START NEW hold is not in the finding register; it was reproduced from the owner's report on 2026-09-23. MA-CI-004 (Day One and start-menu probes outside the trusted roster) is related coverage context only: this change adds one new trusted probe but does not re-verify or change that finding's recorded state.
